verdict.rationale: PostHog's first-party product-analytics docs say you can build funnel insights on the events you already send, save them to dashboards, and run funnels from MCP clients. That covers the core of the story, but only through brief one-line mentions with no detail. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-step funnel configuration, property filters, breakdowns, and drop-off/conversion visualization, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
